name: GROMACS
description: Builds GROMACS 2026.4 into /usr/local for the x86-64-v3 baseline (AVX2) with the FFTW of the fftw Feature and OpenBLAS: gmx with thread-MPI for one node, and gmx_mpi with the image's MPI when it has one. The cuda variant runs non-bonded, PME, bonded and update work on NVIDIA GPUs.

variant.description: cpu: SIMD and OpenMP only. cuda: additionally the CUDA GPU kernels and cuFFT; requires the CUDA base image.

cmakeArgs.description: Extra CMake arguments, space separated, applied last. All checks still apply.
